_howto: Auto-filled by ./cc scout from osm. Verify everything, then write headline, services and reviews by hand — that is the part that sells.
name: Urban Cutz
_liveUrl: The address it will be served from. Setting it adds the canonical link, og:url and schema URL — without it Google has to guess which address is the real one. ./cc host requires it.
_confirmed: What the OWNER has signed off, not what you think is right. ./cc host refuses to write a deployable folder until all four are true, because a price we picked is one they have to honour and an email we guessed swallows enquiries silently.
_services: Every service becomes a tappable row people can select, and the selection is texted or emailed to the business as a booking request. "group" sorts rows under a heading. "price" and "duration" are optional — give them only if the business actually published them, never guessed; without them the rows still select and still send.
_booking: If they already use a booking platform, put its link here and the Request button sends people there instead of composing a text.
